name: Beast Gang
detailed_description:
Line up cards vertically, horizontally, and diagonally to complete hands!
An all-new casual puzzle experience that anyone can enjoy!

Place cards on a 5×5 board—simple controls, yet surprisingly deep strategy!
Feel the thrill as your combos chain together with satisfying effects in a puzzle game that’s as stimulating as it is addictive!

◆ Point 1: The thrill of completing combos is addictive!

Just by placing cards, hands come together!
When multiple hands line up at once, it delivers a rush of satisfaction.
Reading one or two moves ahead makes every choice exciting!

◆ Point 2: Placement is everything!

Depending on where you place each card, you can complete multiple hands at once.
A single decision can change everything—use your strategy and intuition to find the perfect layout!

◆ Point 3: Endlessly replayable challenge mode!

Once you use up the deck, a new round begins!
Endless mode lets you test your limits as long as you can keep scoring. How far can you go?

◆ Point 4: Turn the tide with special items!

When things get tough, unleash powerful items to shift the board in your favor!
Miracle placements and massive chains await—anything can happen until the very end!

A puzzle game that blends strategy, intuition, and a touch of luck.
Easy to pick up, impossible to put down!
